# Moster Smart TVs

> Kerala's leading smart TV and home electronics brand by Iriss Electronics.

Moster offers affordable, high-quality Smart TVs (Android, Google, and WebOS), Speakers, and Washing Machines designed for Indian homes. Available online at [mostertv.com](https://www.mostertv.com) and at showrooms in Trivandrum, Kochi, and Calicut, Kerala, India.

## Website Structure

- [Home](https://www.mostertv.com/): Main landing page showcasing best sellers, customer reviews, and brand overview
- [About Us](https://www.mostertv.com/about.html): Company story, values, why-choose-us features, and customer testimonials
- [Products / Shop](https://www.mostertv.com/shop.html): Full product catalog with category filtering (Moster Prime TV, Moster TV, Nicer TV, Speaker, Washing Machine)
- [Contact](https://www.mostertv.com/contact.html): Contact form, working hours, and store locations with maps for Trivandrum, Kochi, and Calicut
